description: This file defines a React functional component 'MultitaskingPrivacy' for managing multitasking and screenshot privacy settings within a web application's preferences UI. It interacts with application protections and device interface for privacy toggles, and utilizes React hooks and components for rendering.

methods.name: MultitaskingPrivacy
methods.description: React functional component implementing a user interface for toggling multitasking and screenshot privacy settings, utilizing React hooks for state and side effects.

methods.name: onScreenshotPrivacyPress
methods.description: Event handler that toggles the screenshot privacy setting both in the application protections and device interface.
